sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD <=35 mK; optical: 1/2.8in 4MP CMOS
features: bi-spectrum thermal + 4MP visible hybrid speed dome with radiometric temperature measurement
visible 45x optical zoom (3.95-177.75 mm); built-in IR LED, IR distance >=100 m
temperature measurement -20 to 550 C via the thermal channel
AI: heat detection, smoke detection, tripwire, intrusion, human/vehicle classification
release_notes: Pro-series thermal + 4MP visible hybrid speed dome that measures temperature through the thermal channel (-20 to 550 C) and slews a 45x visible zoom for perimeter protection and heat detection.

frigate.notes: Dahua RTSP convention; channel 1 = visible/fusion, channel 2 = thermal. Not verified against a live unit.

home_assistant.notes: Dahua ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and visible exposed as separate channels (visible = channel 1, thermal = channel 2).
